motivation.observed_boundary: joint_ABM produced zero contraction in 64/64 stochastic runs even after all 33 structurally reachable positive nodes were observed.
motivation.rule: No generator, candidate-world, associate, or observation parameter may be changed in this audit.

theorem_to_audit.statement: For positive-only complete support R, C(R)={w: R is a subset of R_w}. Therefore if R1 is a subset of R2, then C(R1) is a superset of C(R2), so |C(R1)| >= |C(R2)|.
theorem_to_audit.interpretation: Within a fixed finite candidate universe, making a true ecological support more restrictive cannot improve positive-only world identification relative to a support superset.

boundaries: This is a post hoc mechanism diagnosis motivated by the frozen v3 S4 refutation.
The nesting monotonicity is a finite-set identity, not an empirical law claimed for arbitrary model universes.
Cardinality alone does not determine ambiguity; set inclusion is the exact ordering.
No surviving world is promoted to causal or historical truth.
